title: Iran Military Storms Tanker In Gulf; Tit-For-Tat Move After U.S Seizes Iranian Tanker Off Venezuela
text: Iran Military Storms Tanker In Gulf; Tit-For-Tat Move After U.S Seizes Iranian Tanker Off VenezuelaIran’s Revolutionary Guard has seized a foreign-crewed oil tanker in the Persian Gulf, escalating tensions across critical global shipping lanes. The interception comes amid heightened pressure from Washington, following a recent U.S. tanker seizure near Venezuela linked to Iranian and Venezuelan oil. While Tehran frames the move as an anti-smuggling operation, the timing has raised alarms far beyond the Middle East. With the Strait of Hormuz carrying a major share of global energy supplies, analysts warn that maritime enforcement actions are increasingly overlapping with geopolitical confrontation.
